### Highlights

## FROM NOVEMBER 10 AS PART OF SOUNDSHAPES: ALL THAT IS BEAUTIFUL, THE SOUND WORK BY HELENA UAMBEMBE AT GALLERIA BORGHESE

Galleria Borghese continues to promote initiatives aimed at offering new ways to interpret its historical and artistic heritage, encouraging ever-different modes of engagement and dialogue with the museum’s works and spaces. In this context comes Soundshapes, a project that brings the language of sound inside and around Galleria Borghese, turning it into a tool for exploration and a renewed perception of the ancient. The encounter between contemporary artistic expressions and historical heritage thus becomes an opportunity to broaden one’s perspective, stimulate new interpretations, and establish novel relationships with the collection and the museum’s architecture.

## BOOK PRESENTATION: “THAT BEASTLY VENUS. TITIAN THROUGH THE EYES OF NINETEENTH-CENTURY ANGLO-AMERICAN WRITERS”

Titian’s Venus of Urbino sparked contrasting reactions among 19th-century Anglo-American writers. Nathaniel Hawthorne and Mark Twain viewed the famous female figure with unease, amidst a debate between those who saw her as merely a “nude woman” and those who recognized her as an ideal of beauty according to new Renaissance canons.

## TITIAN. DIALOGUES BETWEEN THE SACRED AND THE PROFANE: GALLERIA BORGHESE MEETS THE ANNUNCIATION FROM TREVISO CATHEDRAL

From 20 October to 8 December 2026, Galleria Borghese presents Titian. Dialogues Between Sacred and Profane: Galleria Borghese Meets the Annunciation from Treviso Cathedral, curated by Maria Giovanna Sarti. This focused exhibition brings together, for the first time, Titian’s Annunciation, on loan from Treviso Cathedral, and works by the Venetian master already held in the museum’s collection

### Highlights

## METAMORPHOSIS EXPERIENCE: CULTURAL HERITAGE BECOMES A GAME

“Metamorphosis Experience” is the new free digital experience that accompanies visitors on a narrative and interactive journey inspired by the themes of metamorphosis present in the museum’s collection. Developed by TuoMuseo, an international collective specializing in the design of innovative cultural experiences, the web app was created as part of the digital innovation initiatives promoted by the NextGenerationEU Plan and the Ministry of Culture, aiming to expand the ways cultural heritage is enjoyed and to engage new audiences through contemporary languages.
